# Templates

Cosy ships with **18 templates** for social media, blog covers, and developer content.

## Social Media Quotes

| Template | Dimensions | Description |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| [Social Quote](./social-quote) | 1080×1350 | Quote with brand styling, portrait |
| [Dev Quote](./dev-quote) | 1080×1080 | Developer-focused quote, square |
| [Twitter/X Quote](./twitter-quote) | 1200×675 | Optimized for X/Twitter timeline |
| [TikTok Quote](./tiktok-quote) | 1080×1350 | Portrait for TikTok/Reels |

## Using Templates

Each template has its own page with:

- Schema reference (all fields, types, required flags)
- Example JSON input
- Default values

::: tip
Use `cosy validate --template <name> --data input.json` to validate your JSON before rendering.
:::
